verdict.rationale: 1Password documents storing and viewing one-time passwords, but nothing in the evidence shows codes generating offline or without a vendor account. Community reports instead say 1Password 8 dropped local vaults and that support pushed users toward a paid, server-stored account. Since the vendor makes no offline/no-account claim, there is nothing to dispute, so the verdict is none.

support.subject: As a power user, codes generate fully offline — no network, no vendor account required just to see my TOTP codes
